trap.label: supposed to
trap.wrong: You are suppose to arrive at nine.
trap.right: You are supposed to arrive at nine.
trap.why: Pela pronúncia, o /d/ final de supposed some, e o aluno escreve suppose. Na estrutura be supposed to, o -d é obrigatório.

mcq.q: Qual indica que algo não ocorreu como previsto?
mcq.why: was supposed to = era para ele ter ligado.
be supposed to = expectativa ou regra.

fix.wrong: We are expected finishing by noon.
fix.right: We are expected to finish by noon.
Students are supposed to wear shoes.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “She is supposed to call.”
Passe para a negativa: “You are supposed to park here.”
rewrite.answer: You are not supposed to park here.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com be expected to: “People expect him to win.”
